vulnerability.name: Redis Replication Remote Code Execution
vulnerability.author: William Smith
vulnerability.description: Redis is configured to listen on all interfaces with protected-mode disabled and no authentication, allowing unauthenticated remote access. A learner can discover the service through network scanning and exploit it for remote code execution using Metasploit.
vulnerability.hint: Try scanning for Redis on 6379/tcp and investigate whether it is exposed without authentication.
vulnerability.solution: Discover the Redis service, exploit it using Metasploit's redis replication RCE module, obtain command execution, and retrieve the flag from /var/lib/redis.
